name: Kindling
tagline: Turns a one-line app idea into a prompt you can paste into Grok Build
description: Describe the app you have in mind in a single sentence and you get back a fully-formed build prompt, written out and ready for the clipboard. Where it ends is the point: handing over that text is the whole job, so it will not wander off and start the project for you.
author: FantomBuildz
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
